author: Antonio Clim
profile_freeze: Exact canonical profile SHA-256 required before evaluation labels are unsealed.
outcome_access: No outcome values are accepted by the admission interface; evaluation labels must be sealed.

estimands.action_correctness: Fraction of independently adjudicated surfaced opportunities correct and feasible, by rule and task family; denominator and rater disagreement retained.
estimands.false_prompting: Fraction of surfaced opportunities judged unwarranted, by rule and task family; not an authorship false-positive rate.
estimands.coverage: Fraction of eligible entity-rule pairs with a non-abstaining interpretation; report absent and unsupported entities separately.
estimands.burden: Reviewer time and rejected-prompt burden per artefact; no benefit claim from uptake alone.

analysis_limits: No current estimator, empirical interval or calibrated decision is produced.
Synthetic conformance manifests cannot establish authorisation, rater validity or population representativeness.
Near-duplicate and concealed contributor relationships require later independent corpus audit.
Sampling, rater codebook, power, multiplicity and cluster-aware uncertainty must be locked in M01/M02 before authorised E02 data are analysed.
